sources.fixtures_results: UEFA public match API for European cups; ESPN public scoreboards for domestic leagues and fallback
sources.match_statistics: Football-Data.co.uk (odds, corners, cards, possession, referee retained) with ESPN fallback
sources.xg: Understat datesData where the page still exposes it; getTeamData JSON endpoint per-team fallback otherwise; shot-based proxy when neither returns data
sources.model_inputs: Goals/xG, shots, shots on target, form, Elo, venue, rest, and optional pre-match team_context (lineup/availability/promotion) or refereeHomeBias when supplied
sources.referee_stats: Regularized (shrinkage) home-win-rate bias per referee from Football-Data.co.uk results. No source used here exposes an upcoming fixture's referee before it is officially announced, so applying this to a specific future match is a manual step, not automatic.
sources.competition_logos: ESPN public league metadata; initials fallback in the UI
sources.players_lineups: ESPN public match summaries; incremental recent-start inference, best effort
